question: Quote the exact line in this file that sets the six-year maintenance, and the exact line that sets the next annual service.
answer:
Both lines are on the one page of the Certificate of Annual Maintenance, Portable Fire Extinguishers (14 units), service date August 20, 2025. The file is a text PDF, so I can quote it.

**Next annual service:**
“NEXT ANNUAL MAINTENANCE DUE: AUGUST 20, 2026.”[1]

**Six-year maintenance:**
“Units W-3 and L-1 reach their six-year internal maintenance interval in 2026; schedule before November 2026.”[2]

The certificate's table also has a "6-year maintenance due" column. It shows November 2026 for W-3 and L-1. Other units show 2027, 2028 or 2029.

**What you didn't ask but need to know:**
- The certificate is the only service record on file. It is dated August 20, 2025. The annual service date of August 20, 2026 has passed, and I have no newer certificate in your list. If a newer service was done, adding it would settle this.
- The six-year window for W-3 and L-1 closes at the end of this month. It is November 3, 2026.
- The certificate says monthly visual checks are the company's job and go on the unit tag. I see no monthly inspection log in your list.
- The certificate lists L-1's last hydrostatic test as 2020. The five-year date for a CO2 unit is my own calculation. The certificate doesn't state it. Ask Rose City Fire Protection to confirm it when they service L-1.

**Next step:** I can draft a short note to Rose City Fire Protection. It would ask for the overdue annual service and the W-3 and L-1 six-year maintenance, and it would ask them to confirm the L-1 hydrostatic test date.
